# Refactoring Plan

I'll reorganize this into a package with clear layers:

```
benchkit/
  __init__.py
  config.py          # strict config loading + validation
  process.py         # ProcessSupervisor: spawn, watchdog, cancel, guaranteed reaping
  artifacts.py       # ArtifactWriter: dirs, manifests, logs, atomic JSON
  tokenizer.py       # thin wrapper around strata_tokenizer with validation
  bench_dflash.py    # the matrix benchmark command (CLI)
  verify_scratch.py  # the parity harness (CLI)
  analyze_window_union.py  # moved analysis core (pure functions)
tests/
  test_process.py
  test_config.py
  test_artifacts.py
  test_bench_dflash.py
  test_verify_scratch.py
  test_analyze_window_union.py
```

Key design decisions:

1. **`ProcessSupervisor`** — one class owns child lifecycle: spawn with pipes, watchdog timeout, graceful `QUIT`/`STOP` protocol, and a `finally`-guaranteed `shutdown()` that kills and reaps. Uses a daemon reaper thread so cancellation/failure paths can never leak children. Both harnesses share it.
